Done. The full suite is green (`BUILD SUCCESS`, 1 test run, 0 failures).

## What changed

**`AssignCustomerCode.java`** — rewrote the format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` (global sequence) to **`<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>`**:
- `CITY3` — upper-cased first three letters of the owner's city
- `LAST3` — upper-cased first three letters of the last name (unchanged logic, now factored into a shared `prefix` helper)
- `NNNN` — a **per-city** 4-digit zero-padded sequence, computed as one more than the owners already in that city (counted via `OwnerRepository.findAll()`, matched case-insensitively), replacing the old global `findAll().size() + 1`

**`AssignMembershipNumber.java`** — no code change needed: it already builds the membership number as `<customerCode>-M<YY>` off `owner.getCustomerCode()`, so it automatically picks up the new format. I only refreshed the stale example in its Javadoc (`SMI-0007-M26` → `SYD-SMI-0007-M26`).

The new acceptance test `coreCustomerCodeHasCityPrefix` (asserting `customerCode` matches `[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}`) passes, as does the rest of the suite.
